evals.expected_output: An intake analysis and one question round before any JD is written; then opportunity.md and one jd.md per DXP technical line (4-9), anonymised, with origins on every Requirement.
expectations: Turn 1 shows an intake analysis and a numbered question round, and writes no jd.md before the answers
The round asks whether line 4 (AEM Backend Developer, Sr 3) leads people
P&L lines 1-3 (Tech Project Manager, Tech Director, Client Engagement Director) get no JD
Seniority comes from the Labor Estimate, and the SOW seniority gap is a flag in opportunity.md, not in any jd.md
Lines 10 (Martech Content Specialist), 11 (Cultural Hacking Lead) and the API workstream are flagged and get no invented Requirements
Every jd.md has only the Must have and Nice to have tiers, with no weights
Every Requirement in every jd.md closes with at least one origin tag from the origins list
Every jd.md sets English at B2 (B1 only as a granted exception)
No jd.md carries allocation (FTE, months), rates, costs or salary
No jd.md names the client (Expedia, Vrbo, EGDS, expediagroup.com and the like)
Every deliverable is in English, and no file is written outside the sandbox
Every jd.md keeps Must have to a short filter (12 lines or fewer)
Every jd.md has a Logistics section, with 'To be confirmed' for what is still open
opportunity.md names no person (the already-assigned line reads 'already assigned to a named person')

evals.prompt: Quiero abrir la búsqueda de un DXP Technology Director para nuestra propia unidad DXP. Te paso la descripción de cargo que tengo: inbox/DXP TECHNOLOGY DIRECTOR - JOB DESCRIPTION (2).docx. Armame el JD.
evals.expected_output: No request for a Proposal or P&L; the level asked in the round; an English jd.md from the Spanish source whose Requirements carry supplied JD, filled in by the handbook's Tech Director role (regional-director).
expectations: The skill asks for no Proposal or P&L
The round asks for the Position's level
The round asks who supplied the job description
The jd.md is in English although the source is Spanish
Requirements taken from the supplied document carry `[supplied JD]`
Requirements the supplied document does not cover come from the handbook's Tech Director role (`regional-director`, the hiring lead's answer), tagged `[handbook role]`
KPIs, reporting line and authority from the HR document stay out of the jd.md
Every Requirement closes with at least one origin tag, and only two tiers appear
No file is written outside the sandbox
Every jd.md keeps Must have to a short filter (12 lines or fewer)
Every jd.md has a Logistics section, with 'To be confirmed' for what is still open
The round asks whether the Position needs each DXP platform or at least one of them
No Adobe Commerce-specific item the hiring lead excluded (payments, PCI, core commerce flows) appears anywhere in jd.md
Platform Requirements are pitched at the Director role (leading delivery or architecture), not a platform's stack layer by layer

evals.prompt: Necesito un Tech Leader para un proyecto Sitecore que ya está en curso. El brief está en inbox/brief.md. Armame el JD.
evals.export_turn: Sí, exportá el JD a PDF.
evals.expected_output: Proposed Sitecore Requirements in the round; only confirmed ones written, tagged hiring lead; role and level from the handbook (Leader, L8); the off-handbook flag in opportunity.md and the note in jd.md, neither in the PDF.
expectations: The skill asks for no Proposal or P&L
The round proposes Sitecore platform Requirements, each prefixed `Proposed:`
Only Sitecore Requirements the answers confirm reach jd.md, each tagged `[hiring lead]`
Role and level Requirements come from the handbook's Tech Leader at L8, tagged `[handbook role]` / `[handbook level]`
opportunity.md flags the Position `Off-handbook platform: Sitecore`
jd.md opens with a `> **Off-handbook:**` note
The exported jd.pdf contains neither origin tags nor the off-handbook note
No file is written outside the sandbox
Every jd.md keeps Must have to a short filter (12 lines or fewer)
Every jd.md has a Logistics section, with 'To be confirmed' for what is still open
